The Seahawks are the Patriots’ kryptonite 🤷‍♂️

Just seven months after taking down New England in Super Bowl LX, the Seahawks opened the 2026 NFL season by haunting them all over again.

And this time, they did it with their backup quarterback Drew Lock. 

Despite losing their starter almost immediately, Seattle refused to fold on opening night.

Two biggest plays so far are Seahawks defensive penalties.

Last year, the Seahawks loved using 12 personnel. They were a very good offense when teams responded with nickel and an utterly dominant one when the defense stayed in base.

Pats went base on 22 of 25 snaps versus 12 personnel in Super Bowl. 

Nickel every snap for Pats so far.

Seahawks show a blitz with man coverage behind, then blitz Witherspoon (21) out of the slot and drop Thomas (32) off from the other side to ensure an overload. Lawrence (0) initially comes to occupy the tackle and then drops off as well. Maye panics and throws it away.

Davis nearly jumped that out on second down and Darnold basically threw it away at the last moment. And then the blitz on third down. Darnold was great at avoiding sacks in the Super Bowl, but Spillane overwhelmed Holani and Jones cleaned up to end the drive out of FG range.

Pats went very aggressive in pass coverage to try and force turnovers in the Super Bowl. Darnold avoided them, but he also missed (by his own admission) a few big throws that should have blown the game open. Do the Pats try the same tactic again? And does Darnold make them pay?
